title: Smith v. Western Carolina Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC answered the complaint by reference to Case 2008-15. It gave no separate yes-or-no ruling on whether Presbytery erred in treating the complaint as untimely; Case 2008-15 held the August 7 congregational actions invalid and voided related Presbytery actions and complaints.
first_summary: Smith challenged Presbytery’s ruling that his complaint was filed too late. The SJC answered by reference to Case 2008-15, which invalidated the August 7 congregational actions and voided related Presbytery proceedings.
summary: Smith challenged Presbytery’s ruling that his complaint was filed too late. The SJC gave no independent yes-or-no answer on timeliness, instead answering by reference to Case 2008-15. That decision held the August 7 congregational meeting illegitimate and voided resulting Presbytery actions and related complaints. The record does not identify which particular ruling in 2008-15 controlled Smith’s complaint.
